title: Brick Solo #025 (원색 블록 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Japanese · 메이크업 글래스 스킨 2단계 · 보통 · 배경 가을 공원(황금빛 오후) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long wavy auburn hair — full body classic multicolour interlocking plastic toy-brick sculpture fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid toy-brick body built from thousands of small interlocking glossy plastic bricks stacked in staggered rows, the bricks stepping in tiny stair-like layers along her curves so the whole figure still follows her body's true three-dimensional shape, a regular grid of round cylindrical studs clearly visible on every upward-facing brick surface, thin dark seams between every brick, nothing lying flat. Dense brick surface — BLAZING bold blocks of vivid red, sunny yellow, bright blue and white bricks across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID a few bright green and orange bricks mixed among them, and glossy highlights catching on every round stud, glossy hard plastic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same plastic toy bricks, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same plastic toy bricks with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the brick figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: dewy skin with a light highlighter on the cheekbones, a soft peach blush, juicy peach-tinted lips.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
